articles.title: Dead Lizard Found in Veg Biryani in UP's Bulandshahr; Food Safety Team Launches Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing the severed head of a lizard allegedly found in a serving of vegetarian biryani has gone viral from Uttar Pradesh's Bulandshahr district, prompting action by the Food Safety Department.

body.html:
A video showing the severed head of a lizard allegedly found in a serving of vegetarian biryani has gone viral from Uttar Pradesh's Bulandshahr district, prompting action by the Food Safety Department.

According to reports, a passerby purchased vegetarian biryani from a roadside cart near the Jahangirabad Chungi intersection in Shikarpur. While eating, he allegedly noticed the severed head of a lizard in the biryani. The customer confronted the vendor, following which a crowd gathered at the spot.

The customer later left the area, while the vendor reportedly said he would discard the remaining biryani before leaving with his cart.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, the Food Safety Department conducted a surprise inspection on July 11. A team led by Food Safety Officer Sunil Kumar Singh inspected the food stall and collected samples of the biryani and other food items for laboratory testing.

Officials said the samples have been sealed and sent for analysis. Based on the laboratory report, appropriate legal action will be taken against the vendor under the Food Safety and Standards Act, if violations are confirmed.

The incident has raised fresh concerns over food hygiene and safety standards at roadside food stalls.

articles.title: Man Held After Alleged Abusive Video Targeting PM Modi, UP CM Yogi Goes Viral in Jaunpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Uttar Pradesh's Jaunpur district have detained a man after a video allegedly containing abusive remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath went viral on social media.

body.html:
Police in Uttar Pradesh's Jaunpur district have detained a man after a video allegedly containing abusive remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath went viral on social media.

The incident took place in Sahabganj locality under the Mungra Badshahpur police station limits. According to police, the accused, identified as Shukre Alam, was seen in the viral video allegedly using objectionable language against the Prime Minister and the Chief Minister.

After the video surfaced online, police took cognisance of the matter, detained the accused and brought him to the police station.

Station House Officer Ashwini Dubey said the accused's family informed police that Shukre Alam was suffering from mental health issues and claimed his mental condition was not stable.

Considering the situation and to prevent any breach of peace, police initiated preventive action against him under the relevant legal provisions and produced him before a court.

Police also reiterated that posting objectionable or inflammatory content on social media against any individual, religion, community or public representative is a punishable offence, and warned that strict legal action would be taken in such cases.

articles.title: Agra Man Arrested Over Alleged Abusive Video Against UP CM Yogi Adityanath; Apology Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was arrested by Agra Police for allegedly posting an abusive video targeting Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on social media. A separate video showing the accused apologising with folded hands inside the police lock-up has since gone viral.

body.html:
A man was arrested by Agra Police for allegedly posting an abusive video targeting Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on social media. A separate video showing the accused apologising with folded hands inside the police lock-up has since gone viral.

According to police, the accused, identified as Rahil Malik (also reported in some accounts as Rafiq), a resident of Nunihai under Etmaddaula police station limits, uploaded a Facebook video on July 9 while commenting on the poor condition of a road in Shahdara. During the video, he allegedly used derogatory and abusive language against the Chief Minister.

Taking suo motu cognisance of the viral clip, Etmaddaula Police registered a case and arrested the accused with the assistance of the cyber team.

Police said the accused, who is around 60 years old and works as an auto-rickshaw driver, was booked under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Information Technology Act.

A video recorded after his arrest shows the accused apologising before police officers with folded hands, saying he had made a mistake and would not repeat it.

DCP City Syed Ali Abbas appealed to the public to refrain from posting objectionable or inflammatory content on social media, particularly against constitutional authorities, warning that such posts could attract legal action and affect public order.

Police said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Worker Killed as 200-Year-Old Kali Temple Dome Collapses During Demolition for Road Project in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A worker was killed and another injured after the dome of a nearly 200-year-old Kali temple collapsed during a demolition drive for a road-widening project in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli district on Friday.

body.html:
A worker was killed and another injured after the dome of a nearly 200-year-old Kali temple collapsed during a demolition drive for a road-widening project in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli district on Friday.

The incident occurred in Mughalsarai town, where the Public Works Department (PWD) was carrying out the demolition as part of an ongoing road expansion project.

According to officials, the deceased has been identified as Baldev Yadav (45), who was assisting in the demolition by holding a guide rope when the temple's dome suddenly gave way. Another worker sustained injuries and is currently undergoing treatment.

Officials said the dome first struck the bucket of the bulldozer, causing it to deflect before crashing onto the two workers, burying them under the debris. Rescue operations were immediately launched by police, administrative officials and local residents. Both men were pulled out of the rubble and rushed to hospital, where Baldev later succumbed to his injuries.

Authorities said a new temple had already been constructed nearby, and the idols had been shifted there after obtaining approval from the temple committee. A pran pratishtha (consecration) ceremony was also conducted before the old structure was cleared for demolition.

District Magistrate Chandra Mohan Garg said PWD officials had been asked to explain the circumstances that led to the accident. Officials also revealed that the demolition was carried out without prior intimation to the local administration or police.

The temple was located along the alignment of the proposed road and was being removed to facilitate the widening project. Police and district authorities are investigating the incident.

articles.title: UP Cop, Lawyer Clash in Violent Roadside Brawl Near Kanpur Court, Viral Video Triggers Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video from Uttar Pradesh's Kanpur has gone viral, showing a UP-112 police constable and a lawyer exchanging punches in the middle of a busy road near the Civil Lines court premises. The incident occurred on July 10 on Beech Road, close to the district court.

body.html:
A shocking video from Uttar Pradesh's Kanpur has gone viral, showing a UP-112 police constable and a lawyer exchanging punches in the middle of a busy road near the Civil Lines court premises.

The incident occurred on July 10 on Beech Road, close to the district court. The viral footage shows the constable in uniform and a man believed to be a lawyer grappling, pushing and punching each other as shocked bystanders gathered around. Despite the presence of another police constable, the altercation continued for several seconds before people intervened to separate them.

The nearly one-minute video captures the two men falling onto the road near a bicycle and roadside barricades while continuing to exchange blows. Traffic slowed as a crowd assembled to witness the incident.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Joint Commissioner of Police (Law and Order) Vipin Tada ordered immediate action. The UP-112 constable involved has been suspended on preliminary charges of indiscipline and allegations that he was under the influence of alcohol. Another constable present at the scene has been placed under line attachment pending an inquiry.

Police have launched a detailed investigation to determine the circumstances that led to the confrontation. The incident has sparked widespread criticism on social media over the conduct of both the police personnel and the lawyer.

articles.title: Mobile Snatcher Hangs Outside Moving Train for 9 km After Passengers Catch Him Red-Handed in Bihar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic incident in Bihar's Khagaria district, a man accused of attempting to snatch a passenger's mobile phone from a moving train was caught by alert passengers, who held onto him outside the coach for nearly nine kilometres until the train reached the next station.

body.html:
In a dramatic incident in Bihar's Khagaria district, a man accused of attempting to snatch a passenger's mobile phone from a moving train was caught by alert passengers, who held onto him outside the coach for nearly nine kilometres until the train reached the next station.

The incident took place aboard the Janhit Express on Friday night shortly after it departed from Mansi Railway Station. According to police, the accused allegedly tried to snatch a mobile phone from a passenger seated near the window. However, nearby passengers immediately grabbed his arm before he could escape.

Unable to free himself, the accused remained hanging outside the moving train until it reached Khagaria Railway Station. Passengers reportedly refused to let go of his arm despite the train's speed, fearing he could fall to his death if released. During the ordeal, the accused repeatedly pleaded for help, while some passengers were seen slapping him.

A video of the incident has gone viral on social media. In the footage, the accused gives different names and identities in an apparent attempt to mislead those questioning him.

Initially believing someone was trying to board the moving train, railway officials instructed the train to slow down. It later emerged that the man had allegedly been caught while attempting to snatch a mobile phone.

As soon as the train reached Khagaria station, Government Railway Police (GRP) personnel took him into custody. Police identified the accused as Barkat Mansoori, a resident of Mumtaz Mohalla in Naugachia, who allegedly has a history of theft and snatching cases.

A case has been registered under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), and further investigation is underway.

The incident has drawn widespread attention, with many praising the passengers for preventing the theft while also ensuring the accused did not fall from the moving train.

articles.title: ATM Uprooted with SUV in Odisha's Baleshwar, Miscreants Drag Machine Away in Dramatic CCTV Capture
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An ATM was allegedly uprooted by unidentified miscreants in the Khaira area of Odisha's Baleshwar district during the early hours of Saturday in a daring theft attempt captured on CCTV.

body.html:
An ATM was allegedly uprooted by unidentified miscreants in the Khaira area of Odisha's Baleshwar district during the early hours of Saturday in a daring theft attempt captured on CCTV.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 2:30 am near Tudigadia Chhak under the Khaira Police Station limits. Around five to six accused allegedly tied the ATM machine to the rear of an SUV using a rope, pulled it out of the kiosk, and dragged it along the road before abandoning it a short distance away and fleeing.

CCTV footage from the area shows the ATM being dragged by the vehicle. Police are analysing the footage and other evidence to identify the SUV and trace the accused.

Khaira Police recovered the damaged ATM and launched an investigation. Bank officials are verifying whether any cash was stolen and the amount, if any, missing from the machine.

The incident has triggered concern among local residents, while police are pursuing multiple leads to identify those involved.

#Odisha #Balasore #ATMTheft #CrimeNews #CCTV

articles.title: Women Chased, Car Attacked on Ranchi-Tata Highway After Minor Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three women travelling from Jamshedpur to Hazaribagh allegedly faced a terrifying road rage attack on the Ranchi-Tata Highway near Dasham Fall after a minor collision with a Scorpio SUV on Tuesday afternoon.

body.html:
Three women travelling from Jamshedpur to Hazaribagh allegedly faced a terrifying road rage attack on the Ranchi-Tata Highway near Dasham Fall after a minor collision with a Scorpio SUV on Tuesday afternoon.

According to the victims, the speeding Scorpio first hit their car and then chased them for several kilometres. The accused allegedly overtook their vehicle multiple times, blocked their path, tried to open the doors, and pelted stones at the car, shattering the driver's side window and injuring the driver, Ranveer Singh.

A video of the incident, now viral on social media, shows the accused allegedly threatening the occupants and vandalising the vehicle. The women said the attackers fled only after local residents began gathering at the scene.

The victims stated they repeatedly called the Dial-100 emergency helpline during the attack. Police reportedly reached the spot about 20–25 minutes later, by which time the accused had escaped.

Following the investigation, police identified and seized the Scorpio involved. The two accused, Rajkumar Mahato and Shoaib Raza, were later called for questioning.

Ranchi Rural SP Gaurav Goswami said the response was delayed due to the interior location of the incident. Police are continuing the investigation.

The incident has raised serious concerns over women's safety on highways and the effectiveness of highway patrolling in the area.

#Jharkhand #RoadRage #WomenSafety #Ranchi #CrimeNews

articles.title: Private Bus Conductor Arrested for Allegedly Sexually Harassing College Girls in Mangaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A private bus conductor has been arrested for allegedly sexually harassing college students travelling on a bus in Karnataka's Mangaluru.

body.html:
A private bus conductor has been arrested for allegedly sexually harassing college students travelling on a bus in Karnataka's Mangaluru.

The accused, identified as Irfan (32), a resident of Karvelu in Uppinangady, was working as a conductor on a private bus operating on the Mangaluru–Vittal route.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 5 pm on July 9. The conductor allegedly behaved indecently with college girls, made obscene gestures, allegedly exposed his genitals, and called the students to the back seat of the bus, where he allegedly subjected them to sexual harassment.

Following a complaint lodged by one of the students, Mangaluru South Police registered a case against the accused.

Irfan was arrested on July 10, and further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: CCTV Captures ₹17 Lakh Daylight Robbery in Delhi: Gunmen Target Finance Firm Employee, Escape
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A finance firm's employee was allegedly robbed of around ₹17 lakh at gunpoint in broad daylight outside an office in Delhi's Gandhi Nagar market area. The incident was captured on CCTV, and the footage has surfaced.

body.html:
A finance firm's employee was allegedly robbed of around ₹17 lakh at gunpoint in broad daylight outside an office in Delhi's Gandhi Nagar market area. The incident was captured on CCTV, and the footage has surfaced.

According to police, two helmet-clad men arrived on a motorcycle and approached the employee, who was carrying cash related to his employer's finance business.

The CCTV footage allegedly shows one of the accused brandishing a pistol and holding the employee at gunpoint before snatching a bag containing approximately ₹17 lakh in cash. The suspects then fled the spot on the motorcycle.

The businessman associated with the cash has been identified as Sanjay.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation. Officials are analysing CCTV footage and other available evidence to identify and trace the accused involved in the robbery.

#Delhi #Robbery #CCTV #Crime #BreakingNews
